card.name: Punctuation after blood pressure terms
card.fires_on: A comma or the word "and" right after hypotension, hypertension or similar cardiovascular terms, usually in warning headings or sentences about blood pressure or fluid problems.

modes.label: Comma after hypotension
modes.description: A comma follows hypotension in a drug-interaction sentence.
modes.example: ACE inhibitors can cause hypotension<<,>> particularly in the setting of acute myocardial

modes.label: And in paired headings
modes.description: The word "and" joins two terms in a warnings heading such as Hypotension and Syncope.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward circulation and exercise words, and away from unrelated name fragments.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining word or comma that comes right after a blood pressure term like hypotension.
